reference.name: Forge Developer Terminal Workspace.png
reference.caveat: AI-generated raster reference; text and exact typography are not authoritative application state. Measurements are approximate.

preserve: infinite canvas virtualization and reading intent
scope.internal_backend: Use existing native BlockBackend for newly created Block panes; retain Unified legacy restore compatibility without restarting live PTYs.
scope.publication: Local commits only; no new master publication authorized.

geometry.running_border_geometry: Same one-pixel border and allocation as all states; glow is paint only.

typography.native_font_authority: Continue to honor existing Main font size/family and ContentScale. Do not silently change configured VTE font sizes to fit the raster. Explicit reference fixture font settings must be recorded separately from production defaults.

component_contract.header: Real command string, optional real description or cwd tooltip, real status/elapsed, native context-menu button. No invented descriptions.
component_contract.status: Existing shell protocol/exit/timestamp state: running blue, exit zero completed green, nonzero failed red. Missing protocol/state is neutral, never a fabricated success.
component_contract.gutter: Separate native draw layer. Number output source rows/logical lines; document wrap policy. Never insert numbers or control bytes into PTY, ANSI buffers, selection or copied text.
component_contract.output: Native existing readonly VTE projection per finished record, no PTY per card; retain source-grid and selection identity. Running output uses the existing active terminal.
component_contract.live_toolbar: Actual command count and existing live/follow state; real existing search/actions, or clearly unavailable controls.
component_contract.composer: Move/reuse the existing active native input clip, with one input owner and bounded multiline growth. Prompt and running/foreground modes must preserve authority and IME/caret visibility. No duplicate active terminal/composer, no Enter expansion, no hard clipping to meet the minimum.
component_contract.organism: Existing single app-level organism; never instantiate per card or cover output/input.

acceptance: Capture new native Block at the reference size and the existing 1356x704 size, recording source SHA, logical size, DPR, and explicit font configuration.
Use actual safe commands yielding success, nonzero failure, and a running process; never print simulated UI/status as evidence.
Verify unchanged Chat presentation with the same fixture and font settings.
Verify exact input bytes, native selection/copy without gutter numbers, ANSI color, Stop/foreground recovery, IME, terminal resize and split identity.
Verify settled history reading does not jump during output or panel actions, and long output uses existing virtualization without per-frame rebuilding.
Preserve legacy Unified config/session parsing and do not spawn/restart a PTY merely to switch presentation.
Reference visual acceptance remains open until actual native screenshots are reviewed.
